en.auto.label: Auto review
en.auto.description: Run without a sandbox after an experimental same-model review of every native tool call and PTC inner call.
en.auto.confirm.title: Enable Auto review (experimental)?
en.auto.confirm.description: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.

zh.auto.label: 自动审查
zh.auto.description: 无沙箱运行；每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前由同一模型进行实验性审查。
zh.auto.confirm.title: 确认启用自动审查（实验）？
zh.auto.confirm.description: 自动审查不使用沙箱。每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前，都会由与当前 agent 相同的模型进行审查；审查拒绝的调用由你批准或拒绝。此功能仍属实验性，可能误放行或误拒绝，并会消耗额外 token。
